node.statement: Apply def-ha-map with the pair (R,P), symbol z^dagger, input y in S_{P,Q}, and test vector x in S_{R,Q}. It defines Ha^Q_{R,P}(z^dagger)y as the unique element whose coefficient satisfies exactly the identity in node 1.3.2. Therefore Ha^Q_{R,P}(z^dagger)y=T^dagger y for every y, so Ha^Q_{R,P}(z^dagger)=Ha^Q_{P,R}(z)^dagger.
